source_caveat: The BF16 GGUF is an upcast of mixed NVFP4/MXFP8 official weights, not a pristine original-BF16 checkpoint.
baseline: Q4_K with --pure; actual fallback types must be recorded
rationale: Shift some bits from two non-repeated early MoE expert layers to layers 6 and 12 in the 3-pass loop. Equal tensor shapes yield a roughly size-neutral allocation.
validity: Exploratory allocation, not an optimized or preregistered quality winner. Verify actual tensor types, output file size, basic inference and BF16-reference KLD if possible before claiming any benefit.
